mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates supply-side expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7.9% signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE crosses above 7.9%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and gross domestic product (GDPC1) indicates dual monetary and demand expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: both FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 increase in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive when both proxies rise simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS decline in late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of industrial production (INDPRO) above 101.36 indicates robust supply-side activity, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive when INDPRO crosses above 101.36.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market strengthening, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases while PAYEMS increases in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises together.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rates (UNRATE below 4%) signal strong labor market conditions, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive when UNRATE remains below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals contractionary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5%.
